scope: Retrospective agreement of the nine frozen fold-0, seed-42, 50-epoch validation exports. This does not pass or replace the legacy replay contract, authorize the legacy runner, establish determinism, promote a model, or permit held-out access.
exact_requirements: selected checkpoint, epoch, configuration and scientific identity

rationale.interpretation: The fixed absolute-only bound is stricter than the referenced float32 testing convention. It is an engineering acceptance convention, not a proved model error bound. Exact discrete predictions and checkpoint metrics remain mandatory. No threshold adjustment follows diagnostic or all-nine acceptance results.

limitations: The one-arm input diagnostic does not prove input equality or deterministic repeatability for all nine models.
Original in-memory training inputs were not contemporaneously fingerprinted; original-window graph-cache comparison is retrospective evidence.
Stored exports are decimal-rounded; finite probability/simplex/collapse consistency uses the separately stated 2e-7 serialization allowance, never to enlarge replay tolerance.
Qualification does not establish calibrated probabilities, future-run stability, five-fold completion, superiority, or test readiness.
The frozen completed_run_receipt and execute_unit retain the legacy gate. An explicit separate consumer must opt into this policy; do not forge legacy receipts or broadly resume the old runner.
